Subculture procedure: Vesicles or clumps disrupted by gentle pipetting. Centrifuge at low speed. Discard old medium and resuspend into fresh. Currently cells are split at ~1:15 weekly. Comments: Vesicles change morphologically and biochemically in response to 20-hydroxyecdysone.
